property_summary: For any address A that is recognized by Bank as supporting the token, calling airDrop exactly once from A leaves tokenBalance(A) equal to 20 and any additional immediate second call from the same address must revert or be prevented by the contract invariant — the buggy mutant allows a second call to succeed and thus can make tokenBalance(A) != 20 after two calls.
change_summary: Relax hasNoBalance to allow non-zero balances by removing the require, letting airDrop be callable repeatedly and changing final tokenBalance.
